title: Zeus Arc IceBorn and Waterpipe Adapter
description: The Zeus Arc Iceborn & Waterpipe adapter will allow you to easily connect your Zeus Arc to your Iceborn for dramatically cooler draws and larger clouds. The adapter will also allow you to hook the Zeus Arc to your favorite waterpipe for smooth water filtered draws. A great way to convert the Zeus Arc into a powerful stationary style vaporizer.
